description.en: Same as GetDistRotCameraPos, but orbits around a character's position (with an optional Y offset) instead of a raw reference point.
Handle of the character to orbit around.
3-element array [distance, horizontalAngleDeg, verticalAngleDeg] describing the orbit.
Y offset applied to the character's position before orbiting.
A 6-element array [posX, posY, posZ, refX, refY, refZ] with the computed camera position and reference point.

example.code:
// Orbit the camera around a character, offset upward slightly
local posref = GetCharaDistRotCameraPos(hChara, [200.0, 45.0, 10.0], 20.0);
